changelog: 🔄 Auto-landscape: video now rotates to fullscreen landscape automatically when playback starts
🔁 Manual rotate button in player controls (portrait ⇄ landscape)
📱 Returns to normal portrait view when you close the player
🧊 Freeze fix: frozen-picture-with-audio now auto-detected within 6s and repaired (software decoder + TextureView rebuild)
🔁 If a mirror keeps freezing, auto-failover to next server
⚡ Previous fixes retained: black-screen watchdog, dead-host filter, cast receiver
